gloss: to become bloodshot; to become congested with blood

definitions.gloss: to become bloodshot; to become congested with blood
definitions.explanation: For blood to accumulate in a body part, causing redness, especially in the eyes.

examples.japanese: ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{充血|じゅうけつ}して⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
⟦{寝不足|ねぶそく}→寝不足：07692_nebusoku⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{充血|じゅうけつ}してしまった。
examples.english: My eyes got bloodshot from lack of sleep.

examples.japanese: ⟦{花粉症|かふんしょう}→花粉症：04409_kafunshou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{季節|きせつ}→季節：01304_kisetsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{充血|じゅうけつ}して{痒|かゆ}く⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧。
examples.english: During hay fever season, my eyes get bloodshot and itchy.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{充血|じゅうけつ}→充血：18535_juuketsu⟧ (congestion; hyperemia) + ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧. Most commonly used to describe bloodshot eyes, though medically it can refer to blood congestion in any body part. The noun ⟦{充血|じゅうけつ}→充血：18535_juuketsu⟧ is also common in medical contexts.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{充血|じゅうけつ}する: eyes become bloodshot
- {充血|じゅうけつ}した⟦{目|め}→目：00525_me⟧: bloodshot eyes
- ⟦{充血|じゅうけつ}→充血：18535_juuketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抑|おさ}える→抑える：12806_osaeru⟧: to reduce redness/congestion
- ⟦{目薬|めぐすり}→目薬：09714_megusuri⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{充血|じゅうけつ}→充血：18535_juuketsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{取|と}る→取る：00565_toru⟧: to relieve bloodshot eyes with eye drops

SIMILAR WORDS:
- うっ{血|けつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to become congested (blood pooling) — implies stagnation rather than active swelling; used for venous congestion
- ⟦{赤|あか}く→赤い：00585_akai⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to turn red — general redness from any cause, not specifically blood congestion
